subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Stakeholder vs Shareholder Ethics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Stakeholder vs Shareholder Ethics usable.

hook.text: Milton Friedman said a company's only duty is profit. Ed Freeman said it owes duties to all stakeholders.

buildup.text: Shareholder theory maximizes owner returns. Stakeholder theory balances employees, communities, and the environment.

discovery.text: In 2019, the Business Roundtable redefined corporate purpose to include all stakeholders, not just shareholders.

twist.text: Critics call stakeholder theory vague. Who decides which stakeholder matters most when interests conflict?

climax.text: The debate isn't settled. But companies ignoring non-shareholder interests face mounting pressure and regulation.

punchline.text: Profit for shareholders? Or value for all? The debate rages.

quiz.question: What did the Business Roundtable redefine in 2019?
options: Corporate purpose to include all stakeholders, not just shareholders
The legal definition of a corporation
